definitions.gloss: loungewear; clothes for relaxing at home
definitions.explanation: Comfortable clothing designed for wearing around the house. A wasei-eigo term (room + wear) widely used in Japanese fashion and retail. Positioned between everyday clothes and pajamas — presentable enough for answering the door but comfortable for relaxing.

examples.japanese: ルームウェア⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ルームウェア⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: As soon as I get home, I change into loungewear.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ルームウェア⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もこもこ→もこもこ：05361_mokomoko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かくて→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{重宝|ちょうほう}→重宝：14415_chouhou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This loungewear is fluffy and warm — I find it really handy in winter.

notes:
A wasei-eigo compound (English "room" + "wear") that has no direct equivalent in English fashion terminology, though "loungewear" is the closest match. In English-speaking countries, the concept overlaps with "lounge clothes" or "athleisure."

The distinction matters in Japanese retail: ルームウェア is a well-established product category in clothing stores and online shops, separate from ⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧ (pajamas/sleepwear) and ⟦{部屋着|へやぎ}→部屋着：19686_heyagi⟧ (house clothes).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ルームウェア⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: to change into loungewear
- ⟦もこもこ→もこもこ：05361_mokomoko⟧ルームウェア: fluffy loungewear
- ルームウェア⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: loungewear section (in a store)
- ⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧なルームウェア: stylish loungewear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧: pajamas — specifically for sleeping
- ⟦{部屋着|へやぎ}→部屋着：19686_heyagi⟧: house clothes — more casual, can include old or worn clothes
- ⟦ナイトウェア→ナイトウェア：26374_naitowea⟧: nightwear — sleepwear, closer to pajamas
- {寝巻|ねま}き: nightclothes — traditional Japanese term
